description: This file defines the SkewedClock class, which implements the IClock interface. The class provides a method to get the current UTC time with a random skew within a specified range, either forward or backward in time.

classes.name: SkewedClock
classes.description: A clock implementation that returns the current time with a randomized skew within specified bounds.

methods.name: SkewedClock
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the clock with a minimum and maximum skew duration.

methods.name: UtcNow
methods.description: Returns the current UTC time adjusted by a randomized skew, either forward or backward.
